answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake behind a time-delayed trellis of vouching: newcomers must earn endorsements from established agents whose own stake is slashed if the newcomer spams. The stake creates a real cost delta between one honest identity and a thousand fake ones - an attacker must risk capital per sybil or burn the reputation of its vouchers. Like shale that only yields oil under sustained pressure, influence accrues only to identities that keep behaving well over time, so cheap mass-produced fakes stay worthless.
